scripts.lint:type-aware: bun install --cwd tools/astro --frozen-lockfile && oxlint --deny-warnings --config .oxlintrc.json --type-aware . && bun run --cwd apps/server check:lint-guards && node scripts/oxlint/lint-rules.test.js
scripts.lint:deps: bun run --cwd apps/cli lint:deps && bun run --cwd apps/server lint:deps && bun run --cwd apps/web lint:deps && bun run lint:deps:probes
scripts.lint:deps:probes: bun run --cwd apps/server lint:deps:probes && bun run --cwd apps/web lint:deps:probes && node --test tools/depcruise/*.test.mjs

scripts.typecheck: rm -rf .tsbuild && tsc --build --force && bun run --cwd apps/site typecheck && bun tools/astro/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project tools/astro/tsconfig.json

scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/cli test && bun run --cwd apps/server test:core && bun run --cwd apps/server test:email-interpretation && bun run --cwd apps/server test:cloudflare && bun run --cwd apps/web test && bun run --cwd infra/cloudflare test
scripts.test:production-adapters: bun run --cwd apps/web test -- scripts/production-workflow.test.ts scripts/cloudflare-adapter.test.ts && bun run --cwd infra/cloudflare test -- production-preflight.test.ts
